summary: Expanded the direct US-listed universe for AI data-center networking and optical interconnect around five high-relevance public companies: Broadcom for Ethernet switch silicon, custom AI/XPU silicon, optical DSP/retimers/AEC/CPO; Marvell for optical DSPs, coherent DCI, switch silicon, SerDes and custom AI silicon; Arista for Ethernet AI switching platforms and AI spine/leaf systems; Coherent for vertically integrated photonics, lasers, transceivers and CPO; and Credo for AECs, retimers, optical DSPs and silicon photonics via DustPhotonics.
